note: Two wooded campgrounds on adjoining peninsulas of Stockton Lake near the park marina (West and East), set back in the trees from the shore. Boat and ATV trailers may park off the pad on the grass. The park closes to the public each November for a managed deer hunt. --Claude

flags: WATERFRONT lakeview -> not waterfront (down: unsure after every source): on leaf-off Esri imagery with the UseDirect site points, the nearest sites are East Campground's F058 / 060 at the tip of its loop, ~70 m from the vegetation line and ~90 m from the low-water shore, and West Campground's 021-024 at its north end, ~110-130 m from the shore; continuous mature woods fill all of it (a treeline buffer), so no open view of the lake from a pad in leaf-on season. The only sites nearer the water are the West walk-in tent sites W1-W5 (~40-60 m), which a 23-ft rig can't use.
